drivers.lead: Leisen's four came between 2018 and 2023, all of them with Adrenalin Motorsport
drivers.note: Scope first, because it changes the answer. These records start in 2010 and the series has run since 1977, under the VLN name until 2020. Across that longer history Heinz-Otto Fritzsche and Johannes Scheid have five titles each, so Philipp Leisen's four is the most in this window rather than the most ever — the series' own report of his fourth says exactly that. None of the four were won in a GT3 car, and that is the other thing worth knowing about this championship: NLS scores its drivers' title on group positions rather than outright ones, so a crew winning its class every weekend in a BMW 325i or 330i finishes ahead of the quickest cars on the circuit. Adrenalin Motorsport built seven consecutive titles on that basis, 2018 to 2024, before FK Performance ended the run in 2025. Danny Brink has three, every one of them shared with Leisen.
